setup.evaluatedOn: T = the court-fixed date the company stopped paying (its matched control is checked on the same date)
evidence: gazette (BODACC), every notice about the company
setup.pointInTime: only facts published or filed on or before T; current-state facts dropped; fiscal years only once filed

warnings: For a client whose accounts are 24 months overdue, the policy gives a 50% deposit, but the program gives prepay (rules deposit_30_accounts_6_plus_months_overdue, deposit_50_accounts_18_plus_months_overdue, prepay_two_or_more_deposit_triggers fire). Fix the rules so they agree with the policy.
For a healthy client with a €40,000 invoice, the policy gives a 30% deposit, but the program gives Net 30 (no rule fires). Fix the rules so they agree with the policy.
